title: A Tale of Three Intersecting Lines

topics.title: Equilateral triangles and constructing a triangle from its three sides

concepts.learning_objective: Identify the vertices, sides and angles of a triangle and name them correctly.
Construct a triangle from three given sides using intersecting compass arcs and explain why it works.

topics.title: Triangle inequality and existence of a triangle

concepts.learning_objective: Use the triangle inequality to decide whether three lengths can be the sides of a triangle.
Find possible lengths of the third side when two sides of a triangle are given.
Relate the sum of the two smaller lengths to whether the construction circles touch, miss or intersect.

topics.title: Constructing triangles when some sides and angles are given

concepts.learning_objective: Construct a triangle when two sides and the included angle are given.
Construct a triangle when two angles and the included side are given.
Decide whether two given angles on a base can form a triangle using their sum.

topics.title: Angle sum property and exterior angles

concepts.learning_objective: Use the angle sum property to find an unknown angle of a triangle.
Explain the proof of the angle sum property using a line parallel to the base.
Find an exterior angle of a triangle and relate it to the two opposite interior angles.
Define an altitude and locate it for acute, right and obtuse triangles.
Construct or fold an altitude and justify why it is perpendicular to the base.
Classify triangles as equilateral, isosceles or scalene from their sides.
Classify triangles as acute-angled, right-angled or obtuse-angled from their angles.
